editorialIntro.heading: Discover Celebrity Beyond
paragraphs: Celebrity Beyond is one of the most innovative luxury cruise ships sailing today. As the third ship in Celebrity Cruises' revolutionary Edge Series, it combines contemporary design, elevated dining, luxurious accommodations, and destination-focused experiences to create one of the finest premium cruise vacations available.

Whether you're interested in relaxing in The Retreat, enjoying cocktails at the redesigned Sunset Bar, dining at world-class restaurants, or exploring Europe and the Caribbean, Celebrity Beyond offers an experience designed around modern luxury. This guide covers everything you need to know before booking your Celebrity Beyond cruise.

Quick Answer: Is Celebrity Beyond Worth It? Yes. Celebrity Beyond is widely considered one of the best premium cruise ships in the world thanks to its spacious design, exceptional dining, luxurious accommodations, innovative venues like the Magic Carpet and Eden, and the exclusive Retreat suite experience. It is especially ideal for couples, luxury travelers, and guests seeking a modern premium cruise experience.

atAGlance.title: Celebrity Beyond At a Glance
atAGlance.subtitle: SHIP SPECIFICATIONS & OVERVIEW
paragraphs: At approximately 141,420 gross tons with 17 decks and 1,400 crew members, Celebrity Beyond accommodates up to 3,260 guests. Below is an overview of key ship statistics.
The layout feels spacious and uncrowded even on fully booked sailings.

whySail.title: Why Sail on Celebrity Beyond?
whySail.subtitle: HIGHLIGHTS & INNOVATIVE SHIP FEATURES
whySail.description: Celebrity Beyond offers a completely different cruising experience compared to traditional mega-ships. Highlights include:

cards.title: Spacious Open-Air Decks
cards.description: Expanded outdoor resort decks with panoramic ocean views and elevated lounging.

cards.title: Contemporary Luxury Design
cards.description: Curated interiors designed by world-renowned designers including Kelly Hoppen and Nate Berkus.

cards.title: Award-Winning Restaurants
cards.description: More than 30 restaurants, bars, and lounges featuring Michelin-starred chef Daniel Boulud.

cards.title: The Retreat Luxury Suites
cards.description: Private ship-within-a-ship sanctuary with dedicated sundeck, lounge, restaurant, and butler service.

cards.title: Infinite Veranda Staterooms
cards.description: Floor-to-ceiling glass seamless balonies that increase usable stateroom interior area.

cards.title: Magic Carpet Floating Platform
cards.description: Cantilevered platform transforming between restaurant, open-air lounge, and tender gate across 13 decks.

cards.title: Redesigned Sunset Bar
cards.description: Multi-level Moroccan-inspired aft lounge with tiered seating and direct ocean wake vistas.

cards.title: Eden Entertainment Venue
cards.description: Three stories of glass combining nature, culinary art, mixology, and immersive performance.

cards.title: Expanded Rooftop Garden
cards.description: Lush garden space with cantilevered float pools extending over the ship's edge.

cards.title: Resort Deck
cards.description: Asymmetrical main pool area with two-story martini-glass hot tubs and private cabanas.

neighborhoods.title: Celebrity Beyond Ship Layout
neighborhoods.subtitle: ONBOARD NEIGHBORHOODS ACROSS 17 DECKS
neighborhoods.description: Celebrity Beyond was designed to blur the line between indoor and outdoor living. Guests will find multiple neighborhoods throughout the ship including:

cards.title: Resort Deck
cards.description: Main pool, 25-yard lap pool, martini hot tubs, and outward-facing loungers.

cards.title: Rooftop Garden
cards.description: Open-air living garden, cantilevered infinity plunge pools, and Rooftop Garden Grill.

cards.title: Eden
cards.description: Three-level glass-walled architectural wonder for dining, drinks, and evening shows.

cards.title: Grand Plaza
cards.description: Vibrant multi-story central atrium anchored by the iconic Martini Bar and LED chandelier.

cards.title: Magic Carpet
cards.description: Engineering marvel scaling the starboard side with varying daily functions.

cards.title: The Retreat
cards.description: Exclusive private enclave with private two-story sundeck, lounge, and Luminae dining.

cards.title: Solarium
cards.description: Adults-only tranquil glass-domed retreat with dedicated pool and Spa Café.

cards.title: Resort Pool
cards.description: Central outdoor aquatic social hub surrounded by sculptural artwork and sun loungers.

theRetreat.title: The Retreat: Exclusive Ship-Within-a-Ship
theRetreat.lead: The Retreat is Celebrity's exclusive ship-within-a-ship experience. For travelers seeking the highest level of luxury, The Retreat is one of the best suite experiences at sea.
theRetreat.description: Guests staying in The Retreat receive dedicated butler service, access to the private two-level Retreat Sundeck, the exclusive Retreat Lounge, and Luminae restaurant featuring signature dishes by Chef Daniel Boulud.
features: Exclusive Retreat Lounge with complimentary drinks
Dedicated pre-cruise and onboard concierge service
theRetreat.footer: For travelers seeking the highest level of luxury, The Retreat is one of the best suite experiences at sea.

dining.title: Dining on Celebrity Beyond
dining.subtitle: OVER 30 RESTAURANTS, BARS, AND CAFÉS ACROSS THE FLEET
dining.intro: Celebrity Beyond features one of the strongest dining programs in premium cruising. Highlights include:

profiles.name: Main Dining Restaurants
profiles.description: Four complimentary main dining restaurants — Cosmopolitan, Normandie, Cyprus, and Tuscan — each offering its own signature design and rotating regional menu.
profiles.quote: Four distinct complimentary dining venues offering rotating regional menus without large banquet halls.
profiles.reason: Allows you to dine in a different restaurant setting each evening without extra cost.
whyFits: Four unique restaurant designs and atmospheres
Custom signature dishes in each venue

profiles.name: Fine Cut Steakhouse
profiles.description: An upscale steakhouse serving prime dry-aged steaks, fresh premium seafood, and an extensive global wine list with overlooking views of the Grand Plaza.
profiles.quote: Classic American steakhouse elevated with premium cuts and panoramic Grand Plaza views.
profiles.reason: Perfect for celebratory dinners and lovers of fine meats and seafood.
whyFits: Prime USDA cuts and premium dry-aged selections

profiles.name: Le Voyage by Daniel Boulud
profiles.description: Celebrity's signature fine dining venue created by world-renowned Michelin-starred Chef Daniel Boulud, featuring globally inspired tasting menus.
profiles.quote: An intimate culinary journey inspired by Chef Daniel Boulud's world travels.
profiles.reason: The pinnacle of gastronomic excellence at sea with bespoke wine pairings.
whyFits: Curated by Michelin-starred Chef Daniel Boulud

profiles.name: Raw on 5
profiles.description: Sophisticated sushi and seafood bar serving fresh sashimi, sushi rolls, oysters, and cold seafood towers paired with craft sakes and cocktails.
profiles.quote: Artisanal sushi, sashimi, and fresh seafood towers in a sleek, modern venue.
profiles.reason: Casual yet refined spot for fresh ocean delicacies and light dining.
whyFits: Chilled seafood towers and raw oysters

profiles.name: Eden Restaurant
profiles.description: A unique open-kitchen dining experience set within the three-story Eden architectural wonder, featuring innovative sensory cuisine and live culinary performances.
profiles.quote: Sensory, destination-inspired culinary artistry overlooking the sea.
profiles.reason: Combines panoramic ocean views, dramatic presentations, and creative flavor pairings.
whyFits: Open kitchen with interactive chef stations

profiles.name: Le Grand Bistro
profiles.description: Charming Parisian-inspired brasserie by day serving fresh croissants and baguettes; transforms by night into the innovative Le Petit Chef 3D animated dining experience.
profiles.quote: Classic French café by day, interactive animated dining spectacle by night.
profiles.reason: Fun, immersive 3D projection dinner beloved by couples and families alike.
whyFits: Authentic French pastries, cheeses, and bistro lunch
Le Petit Chef interactive 3D table projection
Engaging storytelling paired with four courses

sunsetBar.title: Redesigned Sunset Bar
sunsetBar.lead: One of Celebrity Beyond's most iconic venues. Located at the aft of the ship across two expansive tiers.
sunsetBar.description: Designed by Nate Berkus, the Moroccan-inspired Sunset Bar offers cascading open-air terraces, daybeds, signature craft cocktails, live acoustic music, and uninhibited 360-degree sunset ocean views. It is consistently rated one of the best outdoor bars at sea.
highlights: Custom craft cocktails and Mediterranean wines
Live acoustic guitar sets and relaxing soundtrack
Multi-tiered terraces with plush daybeds & alcoves
Consistently rated the #1 outdoor bar at sea

magicCarpet.title: The Magic Carpet
magicCarpet.lead: The Magic Carpet is Celebrity's signature cantilevered floating platform attached to the starboard side.
magicCarpet.description: Reaching heights of 13 stories above sea level, this tennis-court-sized platform moves between decks. Depending on its position, it serves as a specialty dinner venue on Deck 16, a sun-drenched cocktail lounge on Deck 14, or a luxury tender boarding station on Deck 2.
highlights: Specialty open-air restaurant under the stars on Deck 16
Extension of the Resort Pool and bar on Deck 14
Luxury embarkation and tender lounge on Deck 2

eden.title: Eden Multi-Story Sanctuary
eden.lead: Eden is a revolutionary three-deck venue blending nature, gastronomy, mixology, and performance art.
eden.description: With 7,000 square feet of glass and lush botanical interior installations, Eden transitions from a peaceful daytime reading nook and café to a lively evening cocktail bar and experiential dinner theater.
highlights: Sensory fine dining restaurant with open kitchen
Botanical craft cocktail lounge & Eden Bar
Three stories of sweeping floor-to-ceiling glass
Live acrobatic performances and interactive theatrical sets
Outdoor Eden walkway overlooking the ship's wake

bullets: Eastern Caribbean: St. Maarten, St. Thomas, Puerto Plata, Tortola
Western Caribbean: Cozumel, Grand Cayman, Falmouth, Bimini
Southern Caribbean: Aruba, Curaçao, Bonaire, Barbados

cards.title: Europe & Mediterranean
cards.description: Summer Mediterranean voyages departing from Barcelona, Rome, and Athens exploring historic capitals, Greek isles, and coastal rivieras.

expertCredentials.name: Angela Hughes
expertCredentials.title: Founder & CEO, Trips & Ships Luxury Travel
expertCredentials.quote: With more than 40 years of luxury travel experience and visits to over 120 countries, I've had the opportunity to sail on many of the world's finest cruise ships. Celebrity Beyond stands out because it combines modern luxury with thoughtful design in a way that appeals to a wide range of travelers. What impresses me most is how the ship balances elegant public spaces with exceptional service. Whether you're relaxing at the beautifully redesigned Sunset Bar, enjoying dinner in one of the specialty restaurants, or staying in The Retreat, every detail has been carefully designed to create a sophisticated yet welcoming atmosphere.
expertCredentials.bio: I often recommend Celebrity Beyond to couples celebrating anniversaries, families looking for a premium cruise experience, and travelers who want a ship that feels luxurious without being overly formal. The itineraries throughout the Caribbean and Europe also provide an excellent mix of iconic destinations and relaxing days at sea. If you're unsure which cabin category, itinerary, or suite experience is right for you, my team and I are happy to provide personalized guidance based on your travel style, preferences, and budget.

faqs.question: Is Celebrity Beyond a luxury cruise ship?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Beyond is considered one of the world's leading premium luxury cruise ships. It offers upscale accommodations, award-winning dining, personalized service, innovative venues like the Magic Carpet, and exclusive suite experiences through The Retreat. While it isn't classified as an ultra-luxury cruise line, it provides a luxury experience that rivals many high-end competitors.

faqs.question: What is included on Celebrity Beyond?
faqs.answer: Your cruise fare typically includes comfortable accommodations, main dining restaurants, buffet dining, theater productions, live entertainment, Resort Pool and Solarium, Fitness Center, youth programs, and ocean transportation between ports. Additional purchases such as specialty restaurants, alcoholic beverages, Wi-Fi, spa treatments, and shore excursions may require an extra fee unless included in your fare package.

faqs.question: Is The Retreat worth the upgrade?
faqs.answer: For travelers seeking a more exclusive experience, absolutely. The Retreat offers luxury suite accommodations, a private restaurant, exclusive lounge, sundeck, butler service, concierge assistance, premium amenities, and priority embarkation. Guests enjoy enhanced privacy and personalized service throughout their cruise.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Beyond have a casino?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Beyond features a full-service casino with slot machines, blackjack, roulette, poker, baccarat, craps, and other table games. The casino also hosts tournaments and offers rewards through Celebrity Cruises' casino program.

faqs.question: How many restaurants are onboard Celebrity Beyond?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Beyond offers more than 30 restaurants, cafés, bars, and lounges, including complimentary dining venues and specialty restaurants. Popular dining options include Fine Cut Steakhouse, Le Voyage, Eden Restaurant, Raw on 5, Le Grand Bistro, Rooftop Garden Grill, Oceanview Café, and Four Main Dining Restaurants. This variety allows guests to enjoy everything from casual meals to fine dining throughout their voyage.

faqs.question: What is the Magic Carpet on Celebrity Beyond?
faqs.answer: The Magic Carpet is Celebrity Cruises' signature floating platform attached to the side of the ship. Depending on its location, it transforms into a specialty restaurant, outdoor bar, tender boarding platform, observation lounge, or entertainment venue. It provides spectacular ocean views and is one of the most recognizable features of the Edge Series ships.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Beyond have Infinite Veranda cabins?
faqs.answer: Yes. Celebrity Beyond introduced the Infinite Veranda concept, where the balcony becomes part of your living space using floor-to-ceiling windows. Guests can enjoy panoramic ocean views while increasing interior cabin space. These cabins have become one of Celebrity's signature accommodation styles.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi included on Celebrity Beyond?
faqs.answer: Wi-Fi is available throughout the ship. Depending on the fare you book, Wi-Fi may be included as part of an "All Included" package or purchased separately before or during your cruise. Premium internet packages are also available for guests needing faster connectivity.

faqs.question: Which itineraries does Celebrity Beyond sail?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Beyond primarily sails Eastern Caribbean, Western Caribbean, Southern Caribbean, Mediterranean, Greek Isles, Italy, France, and Spain. Most itineraries range between 7 and 12 nights, with seasonal repositioning cruises offering additional destinations.

faqs.question: Is Celebrity Beyond good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes. Although Celebrity Cruises is known for appealing to couples and adults, Celebrity Beyond is also an excellent option for families. Families enjoy the Camp at Sea youth program, family-friendly dining, spacious staterooms, multiple pools, interactive activities, and entertainment suitable for all ages. Multi-generational families especially appreciate the ship's spacious public areas and suite accommodations.

faqs.question: What makes Celebrity Beyond different from Celebrity Edge?
faqs.answer: Celebrity Beyond builds upon the success of Celebrity Edge with several enhancements, including a larger Resort Deck, expanded Sunset Bar, bigger Rooftop Garden, additional suite accommodations, larger public spaces, more restaurants and lounges, and an enhanced Retreat experience. Many guests consider Beyond to be the most refined ship in the Edge Series.

faqs.question: Is Celebrity Beyond worth the money?
faqs.answer: For travelers looking for premium accommodations, exceptional dining, elegant design, and outstanding service, Celebrity Beyond offers excellent value. Its modern amenities, luxurious public spaces, and destination-focused itineraries make it one of the highest-rated premium cruise ships available today.

faqs.question: Which cabin is best on Celebrity Beyond?
faqs.answer: The best cabin depends on your travel style. Inside Stateroom offers the best value, Ocean View provides great natural light, Infinite Veranda is the most popular choice, Concierge Class adds extra amenities, AquaClass suits spa-focused travelers, and Retreat Suites offer the ultimate luxury experience with butler service and exclusive access. For the most luxurious vacation, The Retreat suites are widely considered the best accommodations onboard.

faqs.question: Does Celebrity Beyond have butler service?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guests staying in The Retreat Suites receive dedicated butler service, including assistance with unpacking, in-suite dining, reservations, special requests, and personalized attention throughout the cruise. Butler service is one of the signature benefits of Celebrity's luxury suite experience.
